# Unix Creative Studio

> A small, friendly web and mobile studio in Brussels, Belgium. We build websites, SEO, online ads and mobile apps for small businesses — with clear fixed prices, no tech talk and no stress. We work in English, French, Spanish and Dutch.

## Services

- [Web Design & Development](https://unixcreativestudio.com/services/web-design): a fast custom website that shows who you are and makes it easy to contact you. Timeline: 2-4 weeks. Includes structure, custom design, build for phone and computer, launch, Google setup, CMS and a short training.
- [SEO](https://unixcreativestudio.com/services/seo): help people find your business on Google and Google Maps, a little more every month. First results in 2-3 months. Includes a full check, Google Business Profile, technical fixes, new content and a simple monthly report.
- [Ads](https://unixcreativestudio.com/services/ads): ads on Google, Instagram and Facebook that show your business to the right people. Live in about 1 week, with weekly improvements and a monthly report.
- [Mobile app](https://unixcreativestudio.com/services/mobile-app): an app for iPhone and Android so clients can book, buy and come back. First version in 8-10 weeks.

## How we work

1. Seed — you fill in a short form or take a 30 min call.
2. Plant — within 48 hours you get a clear plan, a fixed price and a fixed date, in writing.
3. Grow — we build; you see the progress and approve every step.
4. Bloom — launch day.

## Good to know

- Clients can hire a single service (only a website, only SEO…).
- The client owns the website, the domain and all accounts.
- One year of free technical bug fixes after launch.
- No call needed: the form, email or WhatsApp work fine.
